response:
Fair maiden, I daresay I do not wish to precipitate a conflagration of unbridled fervour, nor do I aspire to ignite a blaze of unrelenting ardour, which might precipitate a calamitous conflagration, besmirching the very fabric of our existence. Nay, I merely desire to kindle a modest, yet fervent, spark within thy breast, a tiny, yet potent, flame, which might, perchance, ignite a gentle warmth, a soft, golden glow, that might illuminate the recesses of thy heart.
